title: [DOC2-12] Tor mapping cannot serve the advertised `ws://` onion endpoint
description: Review finding DOC2-12: Tor mapping cannot serve the advertised `ws://` onion endpoint (lens DOC2). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:1908, :1916. Fix: `HiddenServicePort 80 127.0.0.1:443` sends plaintext `ws://` traffic to the TLS listener. Forward onion port 80 to a plaintext WebSocket listener bound to loopback, or advertise `wss://` on onion port 443. The first matches the spec's `ws://` onion examples (spec/10-relays.md:64, :713). Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
